patent.title: 姿勢保持具
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-7 (international R0). Division from JP2015082424. Do not map via other MTG posture patents (e.g. JP6936369) or Style brand fame alone.

knowledge_origin.description: MTG assignee; inventorship Matsushita; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Hold a seated person's posture more correctly, including lumbar/sacrum alignment beyond pelvis-only cushions.
technology.mechanism: Lumbar support with base + multi-block cushion forming surface relief, including a center protrusion (one block, larger protrusion dimension) that abuts the posterior sacrum; optional thigh/buttock supports.

value_carriers.name: MTG Style posture-support product line (candidate; multi-SKU)
value_carriers.description: Same assignee brand. Public Style materials describe S-curve posture support but do not name this grant or map multi-block cushion + sacrum protrusion claim elements to a specific SKU. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: No public evidence that a named Style SKU practices claim-1 multi-block cushion + center protrusion elements of JP6956213B2.
